strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
Earth Federation Army Far East Command, Izu Base
What's the evacuation status of non-combatants?
About 80% are in the shelters, but the contractors at@the base's perimeter facilities are evacuating late.
Lives come first. The ID checks can wait.@Get them into the nearest shelters, fast.@But keep a close watch inside.
Commander, Major Gilliam Jaeger@is requesting permission to sortie.
Gravity quake reading overhead intensifying!@No sign of their numbers increasing!
Have you identified the <ES Wave Pattern>?
Gravity quake reading overhead intensifying further!@10 seconds until projected warp-in!
If it's not the Zovorg, they'll very likely@strike a decisive blow right away. Only one target@is warping in. Bring it down!
That one... hasn't come out, then. In that case...
Damn, the field generator@and cooling unit...!
That black unit...@It shielded the command tower with itself.
Over 60 seconds for forced heat venting...@If I cancel it, one action is the limit...@Will that be enough to distract him?
Can't move, or won't? Either way,@I've secured the space.
Multiple gravity quake readings above the base!@Something appears to be warping in!
Enemy reinforcements! What about anti-air weapons?!
That last attack disabled every one of them!
There you are. I leave the remaining units to you.
Two reactions... I see, that one is here too...@I should have expected as much.
But I cannot allow myself to waver.@Even if Lord E-Selda comes out...!
I almost got crushed under that panel...
What about the others?! Are they safe?!
...Sounds like things up there are going pretty badly.@I'm going out in Bellzelute.
That's right. I'm not about to die in this hole.@Let's go, Tenia.
I-I couldn't cover her all the way... Ugh...
Damn! Are they trying to blast through the ceiling?!
Doctor, aren't there any spare Personal Troopers@or Armored Modules?!
Granteed can't go out, huh?@Akemi, we're sortieing in the Soul Saber!
Right now, we're the only ones who can go out,@the only ones who can protect everyone!
He should be at the surface facilities right now!@Akemi, we've got no choice but to do this ourselves!
(And I can't sortie at a time like this...!)
Anyway, let's get Tenia and Katia out of here!@Give me a hand!
Katia moved Granteed, and Tenia moved@Bellzelute... So I thought maybe@I could do the same thing.
I want to know.@Why Ashurey Kreuzer was attacked...
That's why I can't die here.@I have to protect Katia, Tenia,@Touya, and everyone.
If you go out with me, I can't guarantee your life.
But you don't plan on dying, right?
Okay.@Touya, please take care@of Katia and Tenia.
(I thought Lord E-Selda might, but...@it seems he's in no state to come out.@Then I'll pry it open myself.)
It broke the hatch... Is it trying to get down below?
Since it didn't destroy the base at the outset,@I figured it had another objective...@Could its target be...
An Orgone Energy reading...!@But this is...
You bastard, you're not getting past here!
(Information is flooding my head...@like I'd known it all along...@So this is Cytron Control.)
Oh, yes. Orgone Extractor...@Cytron Control... Linkage rate...
I think I can manage.@Though I feel like I'm not myself...
Good.@Everything displayed as Unknown is an enemy.@Their commander unit is...
It's you! You're the one who attacked Ashurey Kreuzer!@You killed Ally and the others!!
He was there that day!@He's the one who killed your parents!!
I'll never forgive him!@I'll snuff him out with my own hands!!
You two stay out of this!@I'm taking him down!!
Akimi, we can't just leave her!@Melua's riding in Bellzelute too!
Forced heat venting complete... Now I can move.@I must stop the <Thorn>...!
(Bellzelute... If it has come out,@I cannot ignore it.)
Pretty bad, it seems.@Apparently several of the intercepting@Personal Troopers were taken out.
The Steel Dragons can't get back any time soon either.@How long can Bellzelute and the Soul Saber@hold them off...?
Yes... Please, Touya...@come with me... in Granteed...
I'm fine now...@Granteed won't move...@unless I'm aboard...
I don't want to die... without knowing the truth...@I want to know... what my father and mother...@were trying to do...
Granteed and I... will protect you...@So please... protect everyone...
I know.@Honestly, I'm scared... really scared.@If I could run away, I would.
Unlike Akimi and the others, I didn't pilot a robot@because I wanted to. The world may have alien wars,@but I was just a normal high school student.
But the moment Dad brought Granteed,@no, even before that, I was already...
I didn't want to admit it.@But the city and this base were attacked,@and Akimi and the others went out...
I moved Granteed. I'm the one who can move it.@I can't just do nothing in this situation.
I can at least buy some time@until the Steel Dragons get back.
You're not going to stop me?
The Steel Dragons have a few people who got there@much like you did... They were students, but they@ended up fighting in Personal Troopers.
They've all accepted it now,@and they're doing what they need to do.@If that's how you feel too, I won't stop you.
I know it's irresponsible of me,@considering my line of work.
But don't throw your life away.@In my position, I'd be in trouble if Granteed,@my research subject, didn't come back.
...Understood, Doctor. I'm going.@Please take care of Tenia.
Right leg Tesla Drive damaged!@The balancer's malfunctioning too.@Ground combat will be tough!
This is why units with skinny legs...!@Then I'll take this into the air!
It'll be tough in this condition!
The <Thorn> isn't serious yet!@There's still an opening we can exploit!
Damn, we've gotta do something about him fast!
The <Thorn> still isn't fighting for real...!@Is he just toying with us?!
It's moving...!@Is it Lord E-Selda after all?!
...This is a secure transmission.@Lord E-Selda, are you aboard Granteed?
Are you with those people from back then?!
Dad... Dad is dead!@You're the ones who wounded him so badly, right?!@Or am I wrong?!
Who are you people?!@What are the imperial family and Sentinel Commander@Dad talked about?!
(Could he really be piloting Granteed...?@Bellzelute is one thing,@but how can he move a Throne Unit?)
(Is it the power of Shune blood?)
To the pilot of Granteed.@That unit belongs to us.
If you surrender quietly and come with me,@I will withdraw. I will also guarantee your life@and that of this unit's pilot.
I'll say it once more.@If you and Granteed surrender, we will withdraw.
And if I refuse... everyone but us gets killed?
But then what happens@to Melua and Calvina...?!
(Someone else is aboard? Could it be...)
(Damn... At this range, I might as well...!)
U-Um, please don't think about self-destructing, okay?
Acting like you can see right through me...!
I asked earlier too,@but you don't plan on dying, right?
No... I have an idea for getting out of this.@May I say it?
If we cut the balancer and purge both legs,@the unit will tip way back. Then the enemy@won't be able to hold Bellzelute with one hand.
Then what?@If we lose the legs in this state,@we won't be able to fight.
All we can do is run.@Let's maneuver with the back verniers@and dive into the underground hangar.
I made things worse and ended up like this...@I can't even hold my head up...
But we're getting nowhere like this.@Fine. Do it.
Okay.@Hip joints, locked. Power supply, cut.@Both legs, purged. Balancer, off.
It escaped into the underground hangar!
I hate fighting without knowing why,@but dying without knowing anything is even worse!
I said I would guarantee your life.
My dad is dead!@Why would I trust someone who takes hostages?!
I chose that method to keep the fighting@from spreading any further... But it's true@that it was conduct unbecoming of a knight.
Then I shall take you and Granteed@by force.
(...He took it head-on.@As I thought, he hasn't mastered it.)
You can't move, can you? Give up.
That bastard's trying to capture Granteed!
...This is Al-Van Ranks.@I'm sending coordinate data.@Warp the Orgo Transfer Base here.
So things went well.@In 60 seconds, then.
Cease your futile resistance.@That is, if you wish to know the truth.
If you come with me and show your submission,@I will answer your questions.@Including those about your father.
If I surrender here and hand over Granteed...@there's no way that'll be the end of it.
You people killed Katia and the others' parents too...@Even if you pull back now, you'll just@do the same thing again, won't you...?
Dad, Granteed,@the reason I can move this unit...@There's so much I don't understand.
But Dad risked his life to bring this thing here.@Until I find an answer I can accept@about why he did that...
I'm not handing Granteed over to you!!
Just now, I thought I heard Dad's voice...
I see... You're telling me@to show you what I can do...@Is that it, Granteed?!
Yeah! I won't let them have their way!
Has something gone wrong?@Could it be Lord E-Selda...
No, he has passed away.@But another Shune has activated@Granteed's Busker Mode.
Reinforcements... No, it'd be better if I went myself.@It'll take a little time, though.
Please. I'll hold Granteed off until then.
No, the Orgone Extractor...!@At this rate...!
Ngh, the Orgone Extractor's output...@That blow from Granteed took its toll.
(But if he can activate@the Throne Unit's Busker Mode...)
(If this situation is what made it possible...)
...Fu-Ruu, I was careless. I'm withdrawing.@Have Jua-Mu and the others fall back too.@I'll send the Orgo Transfer Base's coordinates later.
Wait, just a little longer and...
Either way,@Touya and Katia saved us...
I have to hold the Thorn back...!
Shielding the command tower with your own body@was admirable. You seem quite skilled.
We've gotta hold out here!@To protect everyone!
However great that new model's power may be,@I won't let it stop me from reclaiming Granteed.
If we get careless and close in, we're done for...!@We're GG-equipped, so we have to keep our distance!
You seem heavily armed,@but you cannot stop my sword.
I've been waiting for this moment, gray Thorn!@You're not getting away. I'll finish you myself!
(Bellzelute is no match for this Raftclans...)
You took Ally and my comrades from me!@I'll never... never forgive you!
However many times you come, I won't hand@over Granteed! I've made up my mind!
(To think I'd end up fighting a Throne Unit@that has manifested Busker Mode...!)
Touya, are you really okay?@After using that Busker Mode...
It wasn't hard. If anything, it felt like@Granteed was lending me its strength.
You said you heard@Seldoa's voice, didn't you?
I thought so, but maybe I imagined it.@It was probably the Cytron System@that told me about Busker Mode...
And then there's the gray <Thorn>'s pilot...@He talked as if he knew you, Touya.
I don't remember him... but that man seemed@to know Dad well.
About the Dad I never knew...@the one named E-Selda...
Touya, you saved us back there.
Using Granteed like that@was amazing, man.
But you're the one who drove off the gray Thorn.
...We went out even though we were told not to.
I don't intend to punish you for that.@In the end, the base was saved.
It's thanks to Granteed's Busker Mode.
Its shoulders and legs transformed and it pulled out@a spear-like weapon, right? So it's a high-output@mode that lets it use a finishing move?
I think that's a fair way to put it.
But we can't activate it whenever we want.
Touya, it seemed like you were talking@with the <Thorn>'s pilot about something...
It's someone I don't know.@The voice sounded unnatural,@like it was coming through a machine.
The Thorn's pilot seemed to think@my father was aboard Granteed.
Yes. And when he caught Bellzelute, he said@he'd withdraw if I surrendered quietly...
I don't know if he meant it.@He also used the word "knight."
Yes.@He said taking a hostage was conduct@unbecoming of a knight...
I see. When we put the report together later,@we may need to hear more from you.
As for what happens next, you no longer need@to put yourselves at risk.@We'll take custody of Granteed.
But I'm the only one who can move it.
I'm aware of that.@We'll likely ask for your cooperation@during the investigation, but...
Do you understand what that means?
Yes, of course... Fighting scares me.@But if I run, I'll never find the answers...@I have to find them myself. That's what I decided.
Hold on, are you really okay with that?
Akimi, Akemi, you went out in the Soul Saber@because you couldn't just stand by and watch, right?
I have the power that is Granteed...@And I can use it...
So I started thinking there might be@something I have to do besides@learning the truth.
I'd like to respect that,@but you can't move Granteed alone.@Shouldn't you talk it over with Katia and the others?
If you're satisfied after that,@I'll put a recommendation to Commander Laker.
(If Touya's made up his mind, then I...)
(...Pathetic. Beaten back, and I let him escape.)
(But the gray Thorn appeared before me again.@things come in threes.@Next time, I'll definitely...)
...Stay away. I don't want to talk to anyone right now.
...I'll say just one thing.@Your quick thinking saved us back there. Thank you.
That's enough. Go check on Tenia.
...I just had a full checkup,@and they said I'm fine.
But you mustn't push yourself, Tenia.
I know. I'll take it easy today.@Still, Touya coming to visit me...@That's kind of a surprise.
...There's something I want to talk@to you and Melua about.
Is it about you continuing@to pilot Granteed?
Yeah... I want to know. Who Dad really was...@why he entrusted Granteed to me... And who@the enemy is and what they're after...
I have lots of other questions too. To find@the answers, I think I have no choice but@to keep fighting in Granteed.
If I don't pilot it, my life might be safe...@But I feel like then@I'll never reach the truth.
I can't move Granteed by myself.@So I want the three of you to lend me your strength.
I'm in.@I've already decided to avenge my mom and dad@and the others with Calvina.
I... want to know the truth too.@I don't want to stay in the dark.
Right now... it's the only thing I can do.@That's why I got in Granteed earlier, too.
(Learning the truth won't bring Dad back...@or the parents of Katia, Melua, and Tenia...)
(But I can't just forget and go on living.@Not me, and not any of us...)
